title: Stock Market Today Live: Stock to buy today: Usha Martin (₹486) – BUY - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Sensex Today, Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates: Find here all the live updates related to Sensex, Nifty, BSE, NSE, share prices and Indian stock markets for 5th November 2026.

The short-term outlook is bullish for Usha Martin. The stock has surged about 9 per cent so far this week. This rise is happening from an important trend line support.

It indicates that the overall uptrend is intact and a new leg of upmove has begun. Immediate support is at ₹466. Below that ₹450-₹445 is the next important support.

We expect the stock to sustain above ₹466 itself. Usha Martin share price can rise to ₹550 in the coming weeks. Traders can buy Usha Martin shares now at ₹486.

Accumulate on dips at ₹470. Keep the stop-loss at ₹440. Trail the stop-loss up to ₹495 as soon as the stock goes up to ₹505. Revise the stop-loss higher to ₹510 and ₹525 when the price touches ₹520 and ₹535 respectively. Exit the long positions at ₹545

(Note: The recommendations are based on technical analysis. There is risk of loss in trading.)
